facts.summary: Biomarker gains but no cerebral blood flow effect · Phase 1 · IW-6463 in healthy elderly, CNS disease · not yet approved
facts.indication: CNS diseases (MELAS, Alzheimer's disease with vascular pathology)

evidence.summary: Effects on cerebral blood flow and markers of bioenergetics were not observed in this study.
evidence.safety: IW-6463 was shown to be safe and generally well-tolerated.
evidence.program_discontinued: These results support the ongoing development of IW-6463 in serious CNS diseases.
